title: Number of Islands
description: Given a 2D grid of '1' (land) and '0' (water), return the number of islands, where an island is land connected horizontally or vertically.

reference.use_case: Counting distinct connected regions in a grid, such as separate land masses in a satellite image or isolated blobs in a scanned document.
system_examples: OpenCV connectedComponents — labeling separate blobs in a binary image
GIS raster analysis — identifying contiguous flood, wildfire, or land regions
Image editors — paint-bucket flood fill of a contiguous region
reference.explanation: Scan the grid and launch a DFS/BFS (or union-find) from each unvisited land cell to mark one whole component at a time, in O(rows × cols). Connected-component labeling is a core primitive in computer vision and mapping.
